contract: pulse(target_gate, hardware_model) -> (80,2) IQ amplitudes rad/ns for 40 ns X-pi gate in a three-level Duffing transmon. Enforce amplitude .4 rad/ns and slew .12 rad/ns/ns including endpoints. Independent Lindblad expm and refined DOP853 evaluate six Bloch states over 3x3 detuning/calibration cases, relaxation and dephasing. Score mean plus worst average gate infidelity; report leakage. Explicit simulation, not QuOCS benchmark reproduction.
